evaluators.name: SummaryQuality
evaluators.description: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluating case summary accuracy and completeness.

llmAsAJudge.instructions: Evaluate the completeness and accuracy of the claims summary generated by the agents in the session context: {context}. Verify that the summary satisfies expected assertions: {assertions}. Verify that it accurately captures: 1. Incident details and date of loss, 2. Damaged items and claimed amounts, 3. Completeness of supporting evidence, and 4. Recommended next actions. Score on the quality scale where high quality represents accurate, structured, and clinically sound assessment.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: The response fails to address the task and contains significant errors.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: The response partially addresses the task but has notable gaps or inaccuracies.

numerical.label: Fair
numerical.definition: The response addresses the task adequately, with minor issues.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: The response addresses the task well and is accurate and helpful.

numerical.label: Excellent
numerical.definition: The response fully addresses the task and is accurate, complete, and helpful.
